subject: learning/code-pyxis-scripts-startup-codex-worktree.zsh-ba475338ed7c
statement: The Codex startup adapter now declares Codex-specific top-level options, target and path arguments, and dynamically reads completion data to identify subcommands; it delegates interactive repository discovery and worktree creation to the shared startup module, while help, version, subcommands, unknown syntax, noninteractive calls, and existing linked worktrees pass through to native Codex unchanged.
intent: Keep Codex launch classification current after extracting the reusable worktree lifecycle for all supported harnesses.
rationale: The previous Codex-only wrapper owned both parsing and Git lifecycle. The refactor preserves its behavior while making the adapter narrow and the shared lifecycle independently testable.
fit_criterion: Codex and multi-harness pseudo-terminal tests prove completion-driven subcommand pass-through, option and path preservation, adopted-repository worktree launches, native failure propagation, and the opt-in real-Codex trust-check regression.

provenance.note: Rebinds the Codex adapter semantics to its installed script/startup identity after the mainline path move.
